plan.name: Measure sandbox working memory and check timing
plan.summary: Complete step 2 of parent #599 in one plumbing PR: replace the real-budget check's kernel-memory-peak rejection with a bounded 100 ms sampler of each contemporaneous memory.stat anon-plus-shmem sum from container preparation through compilation, touched tests and acceptance, rejecting a sampled sum at or above memory.max, any oom or oom_kill, process exhaustion, or missing, malformed or unavailable required counters and sampling evidence, while retaining kernel memory.peak, memory.events max, complete cpu.max/cpu.stat and elapsed-time diagnostics and enforced-limit checks. Persist exactly one identified host report per container during work and through normal exit, failure, cancellation and forced removal, take a bounded final observation when possible, preserve earlier sampled peaks and cumulative OOM/process/CPU evidence and sticky observer failures across merges, distinguish incomplete samples from final evidence, tolerate only a late removal race after a valid completed report, and always delegate cleanup. Retain measured elapsed_seconds in Result.TestResults with absent distinct from zero and all existing identities, emit explicit phase_start records for prepare, build, test and accept, report per-phase sampled working-memory peaks, sample counts, CPU deltas and wall times, and log at most 20 slowest completed top-level tests per real sandbox with package, test, phase and duration; preserve compact ordinary summaries, acceptance attribution, verdicts, scheduling and untrusted timing-cache behavior, and update the existing budget and CPU observer fixtures with daemon-free coverage using the actual observer, runner, local cgroup files and command boundaries. Keep the four-CPU default and host override, eight workers, 4 GiB and 1,024-process caps, queue, ordinary ten/twelve-minute and verify twenty/twenty-five-minute budgets, image acquisition outside timing, the two fresh-cache runs that must both pass before 25 minutes and three fresh-cache runs that must all return before 26 minutes 15 seconds with named partial results allowed, and the preceding step's integration stress coverage. Update SPEC.md with existing decision citations and docs/factory.md behind the README's existing link to explain the accounting rule, report schema, 100 ms sampling limitation (not a kernel high-water mark), diagnostic procedure and Merger work: record the new accounting/measurement decision refining D-0281 and D-0313 while preserving D-0350 under D-0105, D-0122 and D-0294, and rerun INVARIANT_PLUMBING_REAL=1 go test ./internal/plumbing -run '^TestSandboxBudgetAndRealCheckout$' -count=1 -timeout 70m on a quiet cgroup-v2 Docker host with the default four CPUs and no competing factory checks, recording checkout/image/host identities, per-container elapsed time, slow tests, phase memory/CPU/wall evidence, sampled and kernel peaks, max/OOM/process counters and both wave outcomes, comparing same-host pre-change measurements where available and explicitly identifying missing or different measurements without claiming unmeasured speedup or capacity; the build cannot write decisions/, and affected real Python and TLAPS suites remain required CI checks.

tests.name: TestSandboxWorkingMemoryRule700
tests.says: The real budget validator permits file-cache saturation and max events without OOM, but rejects working-memory exhaustion, OOM with or without kills, process exhaustion and absent or malformed required measurement evidence.

tests.name: TestSandboxSamplesDuringWork700
tests.says: The actual observer samples local cgroup files during every phase, retains peaks before exit using contemporaneous anon-plus-shmem sums, reports CPU and wall evidence, and retains sampling failures even after later healthy observations.

tests.name: TestSandboxResourcesSurviveRemoval700
tests.says: One identified host report survives cancellation and forced removal with accumulated peaks and CPU/OOM/process evidence; incomplete evidence cannot mask failed final observation and observer failures never prevent cleanup.

tests.name: TestSandboxMeasuredResultsAndPhases700
tests.says: Real fixture execution emits preparation, compilation, touched-test and acceptance starts before their work and retains measured test durations and identities, independently of cache hints, with measured zero distinct from absence and ordinary summaries and verdicts preserved.
